summary: Focused frontend re-test of the visual bug (logo + turbo FAB) plus chat regression at mobile viewport 390x844. Both the Vitrina Automotriz logo (brand-logo, 180x52 at top-left of the home header) and the floating Turbo button (turbo-fab, 64x64 at bottom-right) render and are tappable. Turbo FAB navigates to /chat, chat message returns AI reply with 1 recommendation card that navigates to /workshop/{id}. Info tab shows info-logo (220x64). Search, category chips, and workshop navigation all work. Bug reported by user ('no veo logo ni boton turbo') is RESOLVED after image optimization.

Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking (likely internal RN Web/Expo). Monitor upstream.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow.* style props to boxShadow in src/theme to silence deprecation warning.
No further action required on the reported bug — logo and Turbo FAB are visible and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Home header logo (brand-logo) 180x52 renders clearly from the optimized asset; turbo-fab positioned bottom-right with proper 64x64 touch target (meets 44pt min).
Chat flow correctly wires session-id and returns recommendation cards with testID rec-{id}; navigation to /workshop/{id} works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test at viewport 390x844. brand-logo bbox {14,8,180,52}, turbo-fab bbox {310,700,64,64}. Chat AI reply may take ~10-15s; wait accordingly. Rec cards use testID pattern rec-{workshopId}.
rca_of_issue: User reported logo/Turbo not visible. Root cause was the original vitrina-logo.png being 1024x1024 with large white borders + watermark (perceived as invisible when rendered at 180x52 contain), and turbo-avatar.png being ~1.8MB (slow/failing to render on preview). After main agent cropped logo to a wide 800x233 asset (261KB) and resized avatar to 400x400 (~220KB), both now render immediately. Verified visually and via bounding boxes.
